name: AM-GM Inequality Disguise
description: Replace the algebraic equation `p_u^2 + p_v^2 = 5` with the condition that the arithmetic mean of the two values must be strictly greater than their geometric mean. By the AM-GM inequality, this is mathematically equivalent to requiring the two values to be distinct. Models that pattern-match on specific equations will fail, while those that analyze the mathematical properties of the constraint will correctly deduce the bipartite graph structure.
